name: Tyler Boyd
strengths: Boyd plays island off-man with a clean 5–8 yard cushion — athletic ready stance, inside leverage shade, and eyes that stay disciplined pre-snap.
Boyd finishes in space: wraps and drives through ball carriers on highlighted stops (red-zone / open-field), and he does not quit on backside pursuit from the CB island.
Boyd flashes press/tight-man when the call asks — physical mirror at the LOS with the compact 5-11 / 190 frame playing bigger than the listing.
Boyd’s ball production matches the tape profile — 2025: 3 INT (2 pick-sixes), 7 PBU, 38 tackles — a CB who finds the ball and finishes.
weaknesses: Boyd’s Full Szn reel leans off-man more than press — White’s man scheme will want more consistent press technique and tighter hip flips versus vertical stems.
comparison: Boyd comps to Jaire Alexander — compact 5-10/5-11 physical cover corner who plays bigger than the listing and wins with twitch, leverage, and toughness in man.
projection: Boyd projects as a Year 2 CB contributor who can push nickel/boundary packages early and compete for a starting job by Year 3. Ceiling: every-down SEC press/man corner with a filled-out 5-11 / 190 frame.
schemeFit: Boyd fits Brad White press/man + pattern-match CB who can live on an island off the hash, finish in run support, and grow into true press technique.
